stories.title: Humyn Labs raises $47 million in Series A
stories.summary: Physical AI startup Humyn Labs has raised $47 million in a Series A funding round comprising equity and debt. The Bengaluru-headquartered company plans to use the capital to build deployment-readiness infrastructure in Brazil, South Korea and India, while expanding its research presence in San Francisco and London.

stories.title: InPrime Finserv raises Rs 101 crore in Series B
stories.summary: AI-first non-banking financial company InPrime Finserv has raised Rs 101 crore in a Series B round led by FMO. The company plans to use the capital to enter the micro-mortgage segment and invest in agentic AI for underwriting and customer service. The Dutch bank joins as lead investor.

stories.title: Boba Bhai raises $18 million in Series B
stories.summary: Bubble tea and Korean street food chain Boba Bhai has raised $18 million in a Series B round led by Left Lane Capital and Big Capital. The company operates 120 stores and intends to use the funds to expand its network and launch new food brands under its platform.

stories.title: Style Union raises Rs 485 crore for national expansion
stories.summary: Value-fashion retailer Style Union has raised Rs 485 crore in a Series E round led by Venturi Partners and Elev8 Venture Partners. The company plans to expand beyond its southern India base into western and northern regions, targeting a total of 450 stores by March 2030.

stories.title: Soket AI secures $4 million from Bajaj Finserv and Pennant
stories.summary: Bengaluru-based Soket AI has raised nearly $4 million from Bajaj Finserv and Pennant Technologies to advance its homegrown foundation models. The startup aims to address the challenge of using AI with sensitive customer data. The investment includes $2 million from a Bajaj Finance investee company.

stories.title: VitusCare raises $3 million in Series B
stories.summary: Dialysis provider VitusCare has secured $3 million in a Series B round featuring HDFC Bank and Liberty Ridge Capital. The company uses a shop-in-shop model to place dialysis services inside existing hospitals rather than building standalone facilities. The capital is intended to support this network expansion.

stories.title: Botsync raises $11 million for robotics expansion
stories.summary: Singapore-headquartered robotics startup Botsync has raised $11 million in a funding round led by IvyCap Ventures. The company, which has raised over $20 million to date, plans to use the capital to grow its industrial automation business and strengthen its presence in India and international markets.

stories.title: Henfruit raises $15 million in Series A
stories.summary: Branded egg company Henfruit has raised $15 million in its first external funding round led by Lok Capital, DSG Consumer Partners and RPSG Capital Ventures. The company, which operated as a bootstrapped business for a decade, plans to expand production and widen distribution across India.

stories.title: Egg brand Henfruit raises $15 million
stories.summary: Henfruit has raised $15 million in a Series A round to scale its supply chain and distribution. The company says it processes over 4 crore eggs a month and serves 15 cities. It expects revenue to exceed Rs 350 crore in the 2027 fiscal year.

stories.title: Lemonpeel raises $1 million in pre-seed round
stories.summary: AI video production startup Lemonpeel has raised $1 million in a pre-seed round led by Shastra VC. The company plans to develop multi-agent platforms for video creation and editing, while building intellectual property around creative workflows and faces for enterprise creative teams.

stories.title: Wealthtech startup finny.club raises Rs 5.3 crore
stories.summary: Bengaluru-based finny.club has raised Rs 5.3 crore in an angel round. The startup operates as an AI-first personal CFO for salaried families. Proceeds are earmarked for AI-led product development, marketing initiatives and the expansion of its financial advisory team.

stories.title: Specialty chemicals startup altM raises $10.3 million
stories.summary: Specialty chemicals startup altM has raised $10.3 million in a Series A round led by Rainmatter and Mela Ventures. The company plans to use the capital to expand manufacturing capacity and accelerate the commercialisation of bio-based industrial chemicals as it transitions from research to production.

stories.title: August AI raises $12 million for healthcare assistant
stories.summary: AI healthtech startup August AI has raised $12 million from Accel, Peak XV Partners and Claypond Capital. The company plans to expand its assistant's ability to book appointments and manage insurance claims in the US. It claims to have helped 10 million people understand their health.

stories.title: Birmingham startup raises $90M Series B as Silicon Valley giant joins board - The Business Journals
Boltz raises $110 million in Series A
stories.summary: Biomolecular AI startup Boltz has raised $110 million in a Series A round led by Bessemer. The MIT-born company sells proprietary models for drug discovery and has signed six of the world's 20 largest pharma companies. It previously built its following through open-source research.

stories.title: Allocator One Launches out of Stealth With $100M+ Venture Capital Fund of Funds, With 17 Unicorns in Portfolio - Busines
Pegasus Tech Ventures and Taisei plan $150 million fund
stories.summary: Pegasus Tech Ventures and Taisei Corporation plan to establish a $150 million corporate venture capital fund for construction technology. The fund will target AI, robotics and automation to improve productivity. It is expected to operate for 10 years, starting in November 2026.

stories.title: Unsiloed AI raises $7.5 million for document processing
stories.summary: Unsiloed AI has raised $7.5 million in seed funding led by Felicis to help enterprises make complex documents accessible to AI agents. The startup aims to interpret tables, charts and complicated layouts that current systems struggle to process accurately.

stories.title: Model ML raises $250m in Series B funding at $1.5bn valuation - FinTech Futures
Genesis AI raises $500 million in Series A
stories.summary: French robotics startup Genesis AI has raised $500 million in a Series A round, valuing the company at $3.5 billion. Investors include Nvidia, Bpifrance, Eric Schmidt and Xavier Niel. The company develops robots that learn physical tasks by mimicking human movements in simulated environments.

stories.title: JohnAIC secures $1.9 million for sovereign AI infrastructure
stories.summary: Bengaluru-based JohnAIC has raised $1.9 million in pre-seed funding led by Crane Venture Partners. The startup intends to scale production to 100 AI servers per month, targeting Indian enterprises that wish to deploy artificial intelligence while maintaining local control over their computing resources and data.

stories.title: Genesis AI valuation hits $3.5 billion
stories.summary: Genesis AI has raised $500 million in Series A funding, bringing its total disclosed capital to $605 million. The company aims to deploy robots that learn tasks from human movements in factories and warehouses. It has been operating since 2024.

stories.title: SE3 raises $30 million for autonomous spatial awareness
stories.summary: Munich-based SE3 has raised $30 million in a Series A round to develop technology for machines operating in GPS-denied environments. The startup uses computer vision and AI to provide three-dimensional spatial understanding. The technology is intended for use where systems must navigate without external satellite signals.

stories.title: Corma raises $125 million for defensive AI agents
stories.summary: Cybersecurity startup Corma has raised $125 million in a Series A round led by New Enterprise Associates. The one-year-old company develops AI agents specifically for cyber defense applications. The funding round brings the company to a $1 billion market valuation.

stories.title: SEBON proposes stricter venture capital regulations
stories.summary: The Securities Board of Nepal has unveiled draft regulations for alternative investment funds. The proposal includes new governance measures to manage conflicts of interest and restricts funds from investing in other funds. The regulator also plans to conduct risk-based inspections to ensure institutional stability.

stories.title: Schneider Electric Ventures expands accelerator to Europe
stories.summary: Schneider Electric Ventures is expanding its accelerator programme to Europe, targeting pre-seed startups in the energy and industry sectors. The fund, backed by the energy giant, aims to help early-stage companies achieve product-market fit. The programme is currently accepting applications.

stories.title: Mudita Venture Partners closes $120 million fund
stories.summary: Detroit-based Mudita Venture Partners has closed its second fund at $120 million, three times the size of its debut. The firm invests in early-stage, AI-first business-to-business software companies. It has already made 16 investments from the new fund since its initial closing last year.

stories.title: Jelawang Capital expands external manager network
stories.summary: Malaysia’s Jelawang Capital has added four venture firms to its external manager programme, bringing its total to 11. The fund-of-funds, launched by Khazanah Nasional in 2024, channels capital into promising Malaysian companies. The new appointments include firms from Malaysia and Singapore.

stories.title: Progressive Ventures closes $12.24 million fund
stories.summary: Progressive Ventures has closed its inaugural fund at $12.24 million to invest in early-stage B2B AI startups. The firm targets companies emerging from accelerators like Y Combinator and Berkeley SkyDeck. Founder Mala Ramakrishnan seeks to provide capital before startups reach their respective demo days.

stories.title: First Circle Capital closes Africa Fund I at $26 million - Africa Business Communities
First Circle Capital raises $26 million for African fintech
stories.summary: First Circle Capital has closed its first fund at $26 million to back early-stage African fintech startups. The firm focuses on companies using AI and automation to build financial services. Investors include the International Finance Corporation, Bpifrance and the Stellar Foundation.

stories.title: Saviu closes second fund at $43.6 million
stories.summary: Saviu has closed its second investment fund at approximately $43.6 million. The firm focuses on technology startups in Francophone Africa. This new fund is four times the size of its inaugural $10.9 million fund, which the company says reflects growing investor confidence in the region.

stories.title: Serena Williams launches Starfire Ventures
stories.summary: Serena Williams is partnering with Beth Ferreira to launch Starfire Ventures, a New York-based firm aiming to raise $200 million. The pair plans to back early-stage startups in healthcare, finance and AI. The firm is designed to operate independently of Williams' personal brand.

stories.title: Anthropic raises $81.3 billion in IPO
stories.summary: Anthropic raised $81.3 billion in its initial public offering, surpassing SpaceX's $75 billion record. The company priced shares at $83, exceeding its indicated range, while reporting $16.2 billion in revenue for the first half of 2026. Its net loss also widened during the same period.

stories.title: Mahanadi Coalfields raises funds from anchor investors
stories.summary: Mahanadi Coalfields, a Coal India subsidiary, raised Rs 2,295 crore from 53 anchor investors ahead of its IPO. The company allotted shares at Rs 136 apiece, with Life Insurance Corporation of India and Nippon Life India Trustee among the largest participants in the round.

stories.title: Mahanadi Coalfields IPO opens for subscription
stories.summary: The Mahanadi Coalfields IPO is open for subscription from November 19 to November 23, 2026. The Rs 8,981 crore issue is entirely an offer for sale by existing shareholders, meaning the company will receive no proceeds from the public offering.

stories.title: More Indian companies prepare for market debut
stories.summary: Bankers report that companies including Foodlink F&B Holdings, Jerai Fitness, and Cult.fit are preparing for market debuts. These firms are targeting growth in segments described as under-penetrated, driven by rising disposable incomes, urbanisation, and increasing health awareness among consumers.

stories.title: Vigor Plast India profile
stories.summary: Founded in 2014, Vigor Plast India transitioned from trading PVC pipes to manufacturing uPVC and CPVC products in 2020. The company holds quality certifications from the Bureau of Indian Standards and operates five warehouses across four locations in Gujarat.

stories.title: Assetz receives SEBI approval for IPO
stories.summary: Bengaluru-based real estate developer Assetz Ltd has received SEBI approval for an IPO estimated at Rs 1,200 crore. The developer, which has a 4.5 crore square foot pipeline, filed its preliminary papers through a confidential pre-filing route in August.

stories.title: Paytm public investors see 1.7x returns
stories.summary: Public shareholders in One 97 Communications have earned approximately 1.7 times their investment over the past five years. An analysis shows public investors collectively acquired 41.5 crore shares at a weighted average price of Rs 1,092 as the stock reached a new high.

stories.title: Ribbit Capital sells Groww shares in block deals
stories.summary: Ribbit Capital sold shares in Indian brokerage Groww worth Rs 19,050 crore through block deals on Tuesday. The shares were acquired by funds affiliated with BlackRock, Fidelity Investments, Kotak Mahindra Mutual Fund, and Societe Generale. The firm previously sold 113.1 million shares in August.

stories.title: Rediff files for Rs 600 crore IPO
stories.summary: Rediff.com India has filed updated draft papers for an IPO of up to Rs 600 crore in new shares. The company, which is 82.52 percent owned by AvenuesAI, noted in its filing that it carried a negative net worth in 2024.

stories.title: Rediff plans platform expansion with IPO proceeds
stories.summary: Rediff.com India aims to raise Rs 600 crore through a fresh issue of equity shares. The company plans to allocate Rs 224.8 crore for developing its Rediff One, Rediff Pay, and Rediff TV platforms, with an additional Rs 183.34 crore earmarked for marketing and branding.

stories.title: Meganet files for $78.6 million IPO
stories.summary: AI infrastructure provider Meganet Technologies has filed draft papers to raise 7.4 billion rupees, or $78.62 million, through an IPO. The company manufactures hardware for data centers and brokerages and intends to use the capital to fund growth amid the ongoing artificial intelligence boom.

stories.title: MS Dhoni shifts to team mentor role
stories.summary: Chennai Super Kings announced that MS Dhoni will become team mentor starting in 2027. Beyond cricket, Dhoni has invested in 13 Indian startups across sectors including fintech, electric mobility, and clean energy through his family office, Midas Deals.

stories.title: Survey finds high rates of unpaid work in India
stories.summary: A survey of 36 markets by ADP Research found that 64 percent of Indian workers report working at least six unpaid hours weekly. The report notes that those working longer unpaid hours are more likely to report higher stress and an intention to leave their jobs.

stories.title: Wald.ai targets enterprise AI security
stories.summary: Wald.ai is developing technology designed to read the intent of employee inputs into generative AI tools. The startup, part of the NetApp Excellerator cohort, aims to prevent the exposure of proprietary code and financial projections that legacy pattern-matching security tools may miss.

stories.title: AI impact on team size and hiring
stories.summary: Technology companies are increasingly using AI to build products with fewer employees. As teams shrink, the importance of individual hires has increased, making the competition for exceptional talent more intense for companies looking to scale.

stories.title: Ineffable founder discusses superintelligence
stories.summary: David Silver of Ineffable told an audience at Slush that he believes artificial superintelligence is approaching. The former Google DeepMind researcher emphasized the need for safety measures as the industry continues to race toward human-level capabilities in AI.

stories.title: Founder predicts AI role in corporate layoffs
stories.summary: Michael Ioffe, CEO of Arist, stated that AI agents will soon play a central role in recommending major corporate decisions. Ioffe expects that within a few years, agents will provide recommendations for workforce reductions, product launches, and other significant enterprise shifts.

stories.title: Page Industries shares fall after profit report
stories.summary: Shares of Page Industries, the licensee for Jockey and Speedo in India, fell 13 percent on November 12. Investors reacted to weak profitability and a disclosure regarding non-compliance with retail trading rules, despite an 11.5 percent year-on-year increase in second-quarter revenue.

stories.title: Wise CEO questions RBI payment caps
stories.summary: Wise CEO Kristo Käärmann has questioned the Reserve Bank of India’s 25 lakh rupee cap on cross-border transactions for fintech firms. Käärmann argued the government should help businesses bring money into India rather than stopping them from getting paid. The regulator has not responded to the critique.

stories.title: Deeptech startups struggle to find first customers
stories.summary: Indian deeptech founders say securing initial commercial orders is harder than developing advanced materials and semiconductors. AGNIT Semiconductors co-founder Hareesh Chandrasekar suggested government agencies should act as first customers to help firms establish credibility with global buyers. Technology is apparently easier to build than a client list.

stories.title: Henfruit raises 15 million dollars after 12 years bootstrapped
stories.summary: Branded egg company Henfruit has raised 15 million dollars in its first external funding round since 2014. The company plans to use the capital to scale its supply chain and distribution network. After a decade of operating without investors, the business is now focusing on branded egg traceability.

stories.title: Zepto co-founder recalls near shutdown during funding announcement
stories.summary: Zepto co-founder Kaivalya Vohra says a major technical failure nearly shut down the application on the same day the company announced its 100 million dollar Series C round in 2021. The engineering team built a solution overnight while the software provider was unavailable. Success requires uptime.

stories.title: The startup ecosystem prioritizes funding over profit
stories.summary: Associate Professor Martin Spiller argues that entrepreneurship has developed a habit of celebrating businesses for raising money before they prove they can make any. The current ecosystem often views building a profitable, independent company as the unambitious option. Headlines are reserved for those who close rounds.

research.title: ARISE: Practical Self-Evolving Memory for Accurate and Cost-Efficient Enterprise Agents
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Enterprise LLM agents operate in dynamic environments where foundation models evolve rapidly, workflows update frequently, and deployments need to satisfy accuracy and cost requirements. We propose ARISE (Agent Refinement through Iterative Self-Evaluation), a practical memory architecture. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Auditable Clinical Support with Decision Agents
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Clinicians reviewing a diagnostic work-up will ask what was considered at each step and why the assessment changed. Agents powered by free text can reach physician-level diagnostic accuracy, but their written reasoning does not always reflect. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: BOS Summary: The First Token Matters
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) and language models (LLMs) often exhibit attention sinks, whereby particular positions, such as the beginning-of-sequence (BOS) token, receive a disproportionate share of attention. Under standard causal masking, however, the BOS query attends. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: BeFit: Shifting Complexity from Weights to Bernstein Activations for Resource-Constrained Sensing
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Time-series sensing increasingly relies on neural networks, yet deployment on resource-constrained microcontrollers remains challenging. Aggressive model compression can reduce accuracy, while restricting weights to multiplication-free representations introduces further losses. We present BeFit, an end-to-end framework that. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Diagnostic Accuracy and Navigation Behavior of Vision-Language Model Agents Reading Emergency CT and MRI Examinations
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Purpose. To evaluate the diagnostic accuracy and image navigation behavior of vision-language model (VLM) agents under varying exploration strategies. Materials and Methods. In this retrospective study, six VLMs read 100 emergency CT and MRI examinations published. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Evaluating Governed LLM-Driven ML Experimentation: Lifecycle, Provenance, and Failure Metrics
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Autonomous agents that run ML experiments are usually judged by the best score they reach. That score says nothing about how it was reached: whether the agent stayed within the files it was allowed to edit. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: FACET - Facet Aware Contrastive Embeddings for Traits- Big Five Estimation from Life Narratives
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Personality is only weakly and inconsistently signaled by written language, and existing text-based methods typically combine language-model and psycholinguistic representations at the input or decision level. It remains open whether a more deliberate combination of the. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: GRAFT: Execution-Guided Genetic Recombination for Agent Design
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Automated agent design searches for executable architectures that improve LLM-based agent performance, with evolutionary methods using language-model crossover to recombine promising mechanisms for task decomposition, model coordination, and verification. This search, however, is typically guided by. Preprint, not peer reviewed.
